name: Phenom Resources Corp.
summary: Phenom Resources Corp., based in Vancouver, Canada, and founded in 2006, procures, prospects, assesses and advances mineral resources in Canada and the United States. It has the exclusive right to buy the whole of the Carlin gold-vanadium venture and the Section 22 site in Elko County, Nevada, and holds interests in the West Jerome copper deposit in Arizona. It was formerly First Vanadium Corp.
